features.name: sqrt_duration
features.description: Square root of the time duration between start and end, reducing the impact of extreme outliers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smoothed, sub-linear scale for duration that helps linear SVMs establish more robust margins without being dominated by extreme values.

features.name: log_duration
features.description: Log-transformed duration between start and end.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the wide range of durations into a compact scale, allowing the linear model to capture multiplicative differences as additive shifts.

features.name: log_size
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the heavily skewed size distribution, making it more suitable for linear decision boundaries.

features.name: log_size_per_duration
features.description: Log-transformed ratio of size to duration, representing the rate of size accumulation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a continuous rate feature that can linearly separate instances based on their intensity or density over time.

features.name: normalized_id
features.description: Linearly scaled identifier, potentially capturing chronological or sequential data collection effects.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the SVM to linearly adjust for any underlying temporal drift or sequential bias in the dataset.

features.name: event_size_interaction
features.description: Interaction term between the event flag and the log-transformed size.
features.expected_model_benefit: Enables the linear SVM to apply a different weight to the size feature depending on whether the event occurred.

features.name: normalized_start
features.description: Start time normalized to a [0, 1] scale based on the maximum observed start time.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded, continuous temporal feature that prevents large raw timestamp values from dominating the SVM margin calculations.

features.name: normalized_end
features.description: End time normalized to a [0, 1] scale based on the maximum observed end time.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded, continuous temporal feature for the completion time, suitable for linear scaling.

features.name: log_duration_size_ratio
features.description: Log-transformed ratio of duration to size, representing the time taken per unit of size.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the inverse of the rate feature, providing an alternative linear projection that might better separate certain clusters.

features.name: event_duration_interaction
features.description: Interaction term between the event flag and the log-transformed duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to fit a specific slope for duration when the event flag is active, increasing model flexibility.

features.name: size_anomaly_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of whether the size is anomalously large or small given the event status and duration, scored from 0 (normal) to 1 (highly anomalous).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a non-linear, context-aware anomaly score that can be directly used as a linear feature to penalize or highlight unusual instances.

features.name: temporal_progression_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of the temporal progression and urgency based on start and end timestamps, scored from 0 (routine) to 1 (urgent/abnormal).
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates complex temporal relationships into a single continuous severity measure, ideal for linear margin separation.
